reviews.title: Was working great till today
reviews.text: Not sure if it’s because my IPad Pro updated to IOS 18.1 but all of a sudden I can’t get notifications,sounds or banners so the app is useless all of a sudden. My sounds are on,notifications are on and my app settings are the same as on my iPhone and Mac book using same IOS 1.  Have to use my phone beside me which will go off to notify me. Even bought Be focused pro thinking that would solve the problem but nope. Please update or help because this was the best Pomodoro timer till these issues started thanks
